factory.name: DashboardGrid.create | DashboardCatalog.create
factory.signature: DashboardGrid.create(host: HTMLElement, options: DashboardGridOptions): DashboardGrid; DashboardCatalog.create(host: HTMLElement, options: DashboardCatalogOptions): DashboardCatalog. Pure layout functions: collides(a: DashboardItem, b: DashboardItem): boolean; clampItem(item: DashboardItem, columns: number): DashboardItem; sortLayout<T extends Pick<DashboardItem, 'x' | 'y'>>(items: readonly T[]): T[]; compactLayout(items: readonly DashboardItem[], anchored?: ReadonlySet<string>): DashboardItem[]; resolveLayout(items: readonly DashboardItem[], moved: DashboardItem, columns: number, compaction?: DashboardCompaction): DashboardItem[]; findFreeSpot(items: readonly DashboardItem[], w: number, h: number, columns: number): { x: number; y: number }; adaptLayout(items: readonly DashboardItem[], fromColumns: number, columns: number): DashboardItem[]

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the dashboard region (aria-label on the host). Non-empty.

options.name: items
options.description: Layout for the widest breakpoint: { id, x, y, w, h, minW?, minH?, maxW?, maxH?, locked?, label? } in column/row units (x, y integers >= 0; w, h integers >= 1; unique ids matching data-aui-item). Clamped to the column count. Narrower breakpoints derive from it unless `layouts` has one. Changing it with update() replaces every stored layout.

options.name: layouts
options.description: Saved layouts by breakpoint name (from the layouts getter or aui-layout-change detail.layouts). Entries for unknown breakpoint names are ignored; a layout for the widest breakpoint overrides `items`.

options.name: breakpoints
options.description: { name, minWidth (CSS px of the host width, >= 0), columns (integer 1..48) }; unique names; one breakpoint must have minWidth 0.

options.name: editable
options.description: Edit mode: move handles, resize grips, keyboard moving, and undo/redo shortcuts.

options.name: reorderDom
options.description: Keep the item elements in visual reading order (row, then column) in the DOM, so focus order matches the layout. Focus is kept across reordering.

options.name: rowHeight
options.description: Row height in CSS px, integer 24..600.

options.name: gap
options.description: Gap between items in CSS px, integer 0..64.

options.name: compaction
options.description: 'vertical': items float up into free space (an item cannot rest below empty space); 'none': items stay where they are put.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the handle names and announcements.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors ArrowLeft/ArrowRight moves and pointer column mapping.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Items of the active breakpoint (copies; derived when no layout is stored for it).

properties.name: layouts
properties.description: Every stored layout by breakpoint name (copies); the widest breakpoint is always included. Serializable (JSON).

properties.name: previewCell
properties.description: Last drop-preview cell of an external drag (the catalog), or null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (validated first; cancels a grab). items, layouts, or breakpoints replace all stored layouts. No event.

methods.name: setEditable
methods.description: Enter or leave edit mode (update({ editable })).

methods.name: addItem
methods.signature: addItem(item: Omit<DashboardItem, 'x' | 'y'> & Partial<Pick<DashboardItem, 'x' | 'y'>>, element?: HTMLElement): DashboardItem
methods.description: Add an item to every stored layout: at x/y in the active breakpoint (colliding items are pushed down), or the first free spot without a position; other stored layouts get their first free spot. `element` is given data-aui-item and appended; otherwise the child with the matching data-aui-item is used when it appears (frameworks render it). Returns the placed item; announces it; emits aui-layout-change (reason 'add'). Throws for a duplicate id.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Remove an item from every layout (compacting with vertical compaction); its element is removed unless removeElement is false (default true). Announces and emits aui-layout-change (reason 'remove'). Unknown ids are ignored.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Replace the active breakpoint's layout (validated, clamped, compacted with vertical compaction). Undoable; emits aui-layout-change (reason 'set').

methods.name: undo | redo
methods.description: Restore the previous / next layout geometry (items added or removed since keep their state). Returns false when there is nothing to undo/redo. Announces and emits aui-layout-change (reason 'undo' / 'redo').

methods.name: previewAt
methods.signature: previewAt(clientX: number, clientY: number, w: number, h: number): { x: number; y: number } | null
methods.description: Show a drop placeholder for an external drag at client coordinates and return its cell, or null (and clear) outside the grid. Used by DashboardCatalog.

methods.name: handleFor
methods.description: The move handle of an item (edit mode only), for focusing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove handles, grips, placeholder, classes, placement styles, custom properties, role, aria-label, observers, and listeners. Children stay.

methods.name: DashboardCatalog.update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render the template list.

methods.name: DashboardCatalog.add
methods.signature: add(templateId: string, at?: { x: number; y: number }): DashboardItem | null
methods.description: Add a widget from a template (id '<template id>-<n>', the template's w/h/minW/minH and label) at `at` or the first free spot. Emits the cancelable aui-catalog-add first; returns null when vetoed. Calls `create` for the element, then grid.addItem, then focuses the new item's move handle (edit mode). Throws for an unknown template id.

methods.name: DashboardCatalog.destroy
methods.description: Remove the list, listeners, and the host class.

events.name: aui-layout-change
events.detail: DashboardGridLayoutChangeDetail { reason: 'move' | 'resize' | 'add' | 'remove' | 'undo' | 'redo' | 'set'; breakpoint: string; items: DashboardItem[]; layouts: Record<string, DashboardItem[]>; id: string | null }
events.description: The layout changed: a drop or keyboard drop that changed positions or sizes (not every live step), addItem, removeItem or removal of the element, setLayout, undo, redo. Save detail.layouts. Dispatched on the grid host.

events.name: aui-breakpoint-change
events.description: The host width crossed into another breakpoint. Dispatched on the grid host.

events.name: aui-catalog-add
events.description: DashboardCatalog: a template is about to be added (click, Enter, Space, drop, or add()). preventDefault() vetoes it. detail.item has the new id and the requested cell (x 0, y 0 when the first free spot will be used). Frameworks render the widget element (data-aui-item = detail.item.id) here. Dispatched on the catalog host.

contentAreas.name: children with data-aui-item
contentAreas.description: Each host child element whose data-aui-item matches an item id is a grid item (the first child per id). The page or framework owns and renders them; the grid positions them, hides elements without an item in the active layout, reorders them within the host, and in edit mode prepends a move handle and appends a resize grip. Removing an element removes its item. Children without data-aui-item are left untouched.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard
cssClasses.description: Grid host (display: grid). Custom properties set through the CSSOM: --aui-dashboard-columns, --aui-dashboard-row-height, --aui-dashboard-gap, --aui-dashboard-rows.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard__item--locked | --dragging
cssClasses.description: Locked item (no resize grip) / the grabbed or dragged item (shadow, above others).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard__handle
cssClasses.description: Move handle button at the item's top inline-end corner (aria-pressed while grabbed).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard__resize
cssClasses.description: Pointer-only resize grip at the bottom inline-end corner (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard__placeholder
cssClasses.description: Drop target preview while moving, resizing, or dragging from the catalog (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-catalog__list | __entry | __template | __icon | __text | __label | __description
cssClasses.description: Catalog list (ul), entry (li), template button, icon, and texts.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-catalog__template--dragging
cssClasses.description: Template button while it is dragged.
